national_news.title: Union Cabinet Passes Resolution Commemorating PM Modi's 25 Years as Head of Government
bullets: The Union Cabinet passed a resolution congratulating Prime Minister Narendra Modi for completing 25 years as the head of government.
Mr. Modi first assumed office as the Chief Minister of Gujarat on October 7, 2001, and later became Prime Minister in 2014.
Information and Broadcasting Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw highlighted the expansion of the governance and development vision from Gujarat to the entire nation as a major milestone.

national_news.title: PM Modi Interacts with GSMA Board Members, Emphasizes Inclusive Technology and DPI
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi interacted with Global System for Mobile Communications Association (GSMA) Board members ahead of the India Mobile Congress in New Delhi.
He emphasized the democratization of technology, making digital services affordable for the Global South, and preventing a digital divide through Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI).
The Prime Minister called for technology-driven solutions to tackle digital and cyber fraud, deepfakes, and AI-generated content.

national_news.title: India and UK Hold 4th Financial Markets Dialogue, Explore GIFT IFSC Listings
bullets: India and the United Kingdom held the fourth India-UK Financial Markets Dialogue in London on September 29.
Both countries agreed to deepen cross-border investment and capital market connectivity, including through equity and bond listings via GIFT IFSC.
Discussions also covered fintech, sustainable finance, insurance frameworks, and London's role as an offshore rupee trading hub.

national_news.title: Anupriya Patel Launches 14th Edition of India Chem 2026
bullets: Union Minister of State for Chemicals and Fertilizers Anupriya Patel launched the 14th edition of India Chem 2026, scheduled in Mumbai from October 22 to 24, 2026.
The government aims to develop the Indian chemical sector into a USD 1 trillion industry by 2040, aligning with the BHAVYA Rasayan Scheme and Critical Mineral Mission.
The Department of Chemicals and Petrochemicals is pursuing priority sector status for the industry under the Research Development Innovation Scheme (RDI) with a ₹1 lakh crore outlay.

national_news.title: Union Health Minister JP Nadda to Lead National Launch of JOSH Teams for TB Elimination
bullets: Union Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, Ministry of Youth Affairs & Sports, and Ministry of Defence jointly launching JOSH (Joint Squad for Health) Teams on October 8, 2026, at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi.
First phase of JOSH Teams to be rolled out across 55 districts in 11 States to promote youth-led community mobilization for TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan.
Initiative brings together Class-I Officers, MY Bharat Volunteers, and NCC Cadets; also features the launch of 'Khushi Avatar', an AI-powered chatbot for public awareness.

national_news.title: Union Cabinet Approves Integrated Transport and Logistics Authority and ₹10,000 Crore SME Growth Fund
bullets: The Union Cabinet approved the establishment of the Integrated Transport and Logistics Authority (ITLA) as the apex body for integrated transport and logistics planning in the country.

ITLA will formulate a long-term National Transport Master Plan with a 10-year horizon covering roads, railways, ports, civil aviation, inland waterways, and urban mobility, complementing the PM Gati Shakti National Master Plan and National Logistics Policy.

The authority will monitor infrastructure projects costing above ₹500 crore and the Cabinet additionally sanctioned a ₹10,000 crore SME Growth Fund to provide equity capital to high-potential Small and Medium Enterprises.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Education Department to Introduce Additional Regional Language for Classes 1-5
bullets: Bihar education department is planning to introduce an additional regional language—Maithili, Bhojpuri, Bajjika, Magahi, or Angika—for Classes 1 to 5 in government schools under the National Education Policy (NEP).
The state plans to create a Plus-II pathway for Madhyama pass-outs through the Bihar Sanskrit Education Board by making necessary amendments to the relevant Act.
Around 24,000 students passed the Madhyama examination in the previous year.

bihar_news.title: SECI Issues Tender for 60 MW Solar Power Project in Gaya, Bihar
bullets: The Solar Energy Corporation of India Limited (SECI) floated a tender for a 60 MWac inter-state transmission system-connected ground-mounted solar PV power plant at Gaya, Bihar.
The selected bidder will undertake complete design, construction, testing, commissioning, and comprehensive operation and maintenance (O&M) for five years.
The tender mandates the use of domestically manufactured solar PV cells and modules from the Approved List of Models and Manufacturers (ALMM).

bihar_news.title: Construction begins on the multi-state 6-lane Varanasi–Kolkata Greenfield Expressway
bullets: The 6-lane Varanasi–Kolkata Greenfield Expressway project is being executed under the Bharatmala Pariyojana, connecting Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, Jharkhand, and West Bengal.
The Hazaribagh stretch covers approximately 48 km across 5 blocks and 26 villages, with land acquisition of nearly 733 acres completed and ₹59 crore disbursed as compensation.
The project will improve regional connectivity to the coal belt, Hazaribag, Chatra, Koderma, and Ramgarh, establishing a faster route across four states.

bihar_news.title: Bihar government emphasizes women's safety and infrastructure development in Rohtas district
bullets: Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary announced strict measures ensuring legal action within 24 hours against individuals targeting or molesting women in Bihar.
During his visit to Rohtas district, the Chief Minister inaugurated the 9.2-km Sasaram Bypass and inspected the Beda Flyover as part of the state's infrastructure push.
Other development initiatives reviewed included the 'Kayakalp Abhiyan' pond renovation, 'Seva Setu Abhiyan' camp, and the inauguration of an astronomy laboratory at a PM SHRI Kendriya Vidyalaya.
